clock.purpose: Running timer in the now-field; stepper value in sheets.

figure.purpose: Counted totals beside pictogram rows; tile values 21u, stats 24u.

title.purpose: Sentence-case section titles with a trailing underlined link; sheet titles at 22u.

tab-label.purpose: Tab bar and rail labels; multiplier capped at 1.3px.

typeUnit.name: --u
typeUnit.purpose: One design pixel of type; every font-size is calc(N * var(--u)).

shadows.name: night-state-ring
shadows.purpose: Night only: marks the running/selected control on the ember field instead of a bright fill. A state marker, not elevation.

shadows.name: invalid-ring
shadows.purpose: Invalid input, with the urgent bottom rule.

shadows.name: scrim-night
shadows.purpose: Behind sheets and dialogs at night.

shadows.name: scrim-day
shadows.purpose: Behind sheets and dialogs by day.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Press scale, sheet rise, switch thumb.

motion.name: press
motion.value: transform 0.12s var(--ease); scale(0.97) tiles, scale(0.98) buttons

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: fade 0.18s only; no scale or slide

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Tighter quick-log tiles and tile values.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Now-field bleeds edge to edge with square corners.

breakpoints.name: two-pane
breakpoints.purpose: 1120px content, 24px gutter, two panes 32px apart; sheets centre when min-height 600px.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Tab bar becomes an 88px left rail (72px with labels hidden on landscape phones).

pictograms.source: icons/pictos.svg, inlined in index.html between <!-- pictos --> markers
pictograms.outlineVariant: fill none; stroke currentColor 1.6px; round joins; opacity 0.7
pictograms.toneMap: js/ui.js TONE: bottle/breast/bowl/pump=feed, drop=wet, poo/diaper=dirty, moon/sun=sleep, tummy/ruler/star=ok, thermometer/pill/syringe=ink; everything else ink

knownGaps: Finish review covered Today only (390/820/1440, day and night). History/Trends, Health, Answers, Settings and sheets were restyled in this system but not separately reviewed; their bar charts, meters and progress bars are not canonized.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that matters: amber at night, ink by day. Flat, 4px corners, 44px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font, Jost, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15.5px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--accent, #E7A54C); color: var(--accent-ink, #070A12); } .ds-btn--primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn--primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #E7A54C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Link Action
components.description: Trailing action on section titles and state rows: ink text with a 1px underline.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: var(--font, Jost, system-ui, sans-serif); background: none; border: 0; color: var(--ink, #ECE8DE); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A7); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #E7A54C); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quick-Log Tile
components.description: One-tap logging: a pictogram over a label on a flat surface tile. The running one is red-ringed at night.
components.css: .ds-qa-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 96px); gap: 6px; } .ds-qa { font-family: var(--font, Jost, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 72px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #10141F); color: var(--ink, #ECE8DE); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.12s; } .ds-qa .ds-ic { width: 30px; height: 30px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-tone-feed { color: var(--c-feed, #E7A54C); display: contents; } .ds-qa:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #181D2B); } .ds-qa:active { transform: scale(0.97); background: var(--surface-2, #181D2B); } .ds-qa:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #E7A54C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-qa--on { background: var(--field, #170F12); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--now, #E0523F); } .ds-qa--on .ds-ic { color: var(--now, #E0523F); }

components.name: Counted Row
components.description: The signature: one identical pictogram per event, filled for done, outlined for the rest of the usual range, a gap after every fifth.
components.css: .ds-count { font-family: var(--font, Jost, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.6em 1fr; column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #1E2433); color: var(--ink, #ECE8DE); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-count__k { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-count__label { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #B8B3A7); } .ds-count__v { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-count__range { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-3, #8F8B82); } .ds-count__row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px 1px; align-items: center; color: var(--c-feed, #E7A54C); } .ds-count__row .ds-ic { width: 17px; height: 21px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-count__row .ds-ic--off { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6px; stroke-linejoin: round; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-count__gap { width: 7px; flex: none; }

narrative.overview:
Baby Log is drawn in the Isotype tradition of Otto Neurath and Gerd Arntz: one solid silhouette pictogram means one thing, and a quantity is read by counting identical symbols, never by decoding a gauge or an emoji. The parent it serves is often holding a baby in a dark room at 3 a.m., so the system has two complete worlds behind one token set. **Night** (the default, `:root`) is a sky chart: blue-black ground, chalk text, amber marks and a night-vision red reserved for the one thing under the eye; it emits no blue light and never lights up a bright block. **Day** (`:root[data-theme="light"]`) is printed paper: flat grey ground, near-black ink, a deep-indigo "now" field, and one colour per kind of thing.

Density is calm and editorial rather than dashboard-like. Sections are parts of one sheet separated by 1px rules, not floating cards. The signature is the "Last 24 hours" count: rows of identical pictograms, filled for what happened and outlined for the rest of the usual range, symbols never resized. Everything is set in Jost (Futura lineage) with tabular figures so times and counts line up like a timetable.

Confirmed rejections from the direction: pastel cards with illustrated emoji, and the neon-dark dashboard the app used to have. No glass, blur, gradients or glows.
keyCharacteristics: Pictograms carry meaning; colour carries only the kind of data.
Hairline rules divide; surfaces are flat and solid.
Tabular figures everywhere; large numbers set tight (-0.01 to -0.025em).
Small corners (4px controls, 6px fields and panels).
Done is marked in place (filled symbol, struck-through row), not moved elsewhere.
Night is the default and stays dim: the running thing is outlined in red, never filled bright.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only to say what kind of thing a symbol is (feed, wet, dirty, sleep) or its status (ok, warn, urgent). Chrome, headings, tabs and section dividers are ink and rule only.

rules.name: The No Blue Light Rule
rules.body: At night nothing is blue: wet turns parchment, focus turns amber, and there are no white or bright fills. A running or selected control is marked with a 1.5px night-vision-red inset ring on the ember field, never filled.

rules.name: The One Red Thing Rule
rules.body: Night-vision red marks the single item that needs the eye now. If two things are red, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Counted Size Rule
rules.body: Every font-size is written as `calc(N * var(--u))`, never a bare px or rem. Chrome that must not outgrow its box (tab labels, badges, pictogram tiles) caps the multiplier with `min(var(--u), Npx)`. Inputs never drop below 16px.

rules.name: The Timetable Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular across the whole body (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`). Times, durations and counts align in columns.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: There is no uppercase, letter-spaced label anywhere. Hierarchy comes from size and weight (400 / 500 / 600) only.

rules.name: The Hairline Not Card Rule
rules.body: A section is a run of the page set off by a 1px rule: rule-strong on top, rule between rows. Never wrap content in a shadowed or bordered floating box. The class names `card` and `tile` in the build mean "ruled section" and "ruled cell".

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow for elevation, no blur, no backdrop-filter, no gradient, no glow. Inset rings are allowed only as state markers: the night red ring, and the 1px urgent ring on an invalid input.

dos: **Do** express every quantity a parent should judge as a counted row of identical 24-unit pictograms, filled for done and outlined for the expected remainder, at a constant size.
**Do** take every colour from the role tokens; switch themes only by swapping `:root` and `:root[data-theme="light"]` values.
**Do** give each kind of thing its pictogram through the tone map so the same symbol always carries the same hue.
**Do** separate sections with 1px rules (rule-strong to open, rule between rows) and keep the ground showing.
**Do** write font sizes as `calc(N * var(--u))` and keep 44px targets; lay out with data-region panes, two panes at ≥768px and the rail at ≥1000px or on a landscape phone.
**Do** mark the running or selected thing at night with the 1.5px night-vision-red inset ring on the ember field.
donts: **Don't** use emoji, illustrated mascots or pastel cards (the category default the direction rejected).
**Don't** bring back the neon-dark dashboard look: no glass, blur, gradients, glows or drop shadows.
**Don't** put blue or a bright filled block on the night screen.
**Don't** spend a data hue on chrome, headings or decoration.
**Don't** use uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows or kicker labels above titles.
**Don't** scale a pictogram to show an amount; add or outline symbols instead.
**Don't** round controls past 6px or float sections in boxes.
